name: Kirishima Ayame
source: The yankee girl whom nobody in the academy is brave enough to approach. Despite her beauty, she tries killing or at least threatens to kill anybody who confesses to her. Ayame used to be a polite and princess-like, but changed in order to go against her family for the fact that one day, she might be forced for an arranged marriage. In other words, underneath the tough girl facade lies a very pure heart.
